beats.name: Beat 1: The Craving for Joy & Meaning

cards.text: Over the black screen, Viviana opens: "I think that it's so easy to desire so many things, um, that we actually don't need."

Over the entrance visual, she continues: "with lockdown, people really sat in their houses and realized that the things that were surrounding them weren't bringing them joy. And I think that's why ceramics has had such a big surge."
Establish a calm, introspective hook that frames ceramics as a mindful return to what truly brings joy.
The video opens on a full black screen.
As the second line begins, cut to visual footage of Viviana opening and walking through the front door into her studio space.

beats.name: Beat 2: Introduction to Viviana & Playful Pottery

cards.text: Viviana introduces her identity as a ceramic artist and outlines the purpose behind creating Playful Pottery as an inviting guide for makers of all levels.
Introduce the author and anchor the film’s central subject—the book as an accessible gateway to hands-on making.

cards.summary: Intercutting speaking on camera with book detail shots and close-ups of pages

cards.text: Cut to Viviana speaking on camera introducing herself and her work, intercut with detail shots of her book Playful Pottery and close-up views of the pages and pottery techniques inside.

beats.name: Beat 3: Creativity, Kindness & Letting Go of Perfection

cards.text: Viviana speaks on the deeper life lessons embedded in clay: practicing kindness toward oneself, embracing mistakes, and viewing creativity as play rather than performance.
Deliver the core thematic message—encouraging personal grace, patience, and non-judgmental exploration in creative work.

cards.summary: Hands shaping clay and pottery tools surrounded by colorful ceramics on studio shelves

cards.text: B-roll of hands shaping clay and working with pottery tools, surrounded by colorful ceramics displayed across the studio shelves.
Viviana encourages creators to stay open and spontaneous in their creative journeys, concluding with the closing thought: "...just letting yourself adjust, grow whatever ideas..."
End on an uplifting, empowering note that inspires viewers to embrace creative freedom and natural evolution in their own art.

cards.summary: Close-up spontaneous crafting and trimming concluding with finished pieces

cards.text: Dynamic, close-up shots of spontaneous crafting in the studio and detailed trimming work, concluding on a vibrant beauty shot of finished pieces.

meta.brief: Plan a ~60-second documentary about Viviana’s book Playful Pottery and what is an important lesson about creativity and kindness the book aims to show.

* Then goes into self intro and about her books

* End with the line “ just letting yourself adjust, grow whatever ideas…"
